recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser canvas game titled **Prism Sniper: Time Wall**. Preserve a two-mode mobile action loop: sniper mode lets the player drag the scope across a generated crowd and tap FIRE to hit the NPC matching jacket/neon clues; ghost mode lets the player drag a joystick, use three shots, manage a cover meter, avoid camera cones and guards, kill the target, then reach an exit lane. Rebuild presentation as a satirical neon noir synthwave sniper/FPS game with prism-wall imagery, gold Wall Executive target marker, magenta/cyan sniper silhouette, glass HUD, compact touch controls, and meme feedback such as “based” and “w rizz.” Use procedural canvas art, approved sci-fi fonts, and safe lightweight feedback media only.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a mobile-first canvas action game with two modes: sniper scope play and close-range stealth/ghost play. The objective is to identify a target from clothing hints, shoot the correct NPC, then either win immediately in sniper mode or escape after the target is down in stealth mode. Wrong shots create panic and signal risk; low cover, guards, or failure to escape can end the run.

## Protected mechanics
- Menu to play flow, restart/menu end flow.
- Sniper mode drag-to-pan scope, center-reticle hit test, tap FIRE.
- Ghost mode one-thumb joystick movement, three-ammo firing, cover/signal meter, temporary ghost/cloak state, cameras and guards as threats.
- NPC crowd generation, target clothing hints, panic/aggression reactions, win/loss semantics.

## Rebuilt target
`Prism Sniper: Time Wall` reframes the same loop as a neon noir satirical sniper contract against a synthwave “Wall Executive.” The presentation changes the world, HUD language, skyline, silhouettes, feedback, fonts, and mobile hierarchy while keeping the underlying shooting, targeting, signal, ammo, guard, escape, win, and loss behavior intact.
